# Ningbo Xinqiu Travelling Products Co., Ltd. (XINQIU TENT)

> A BSCI-audited Chinese tent manufacturer that began production in 2006, operating a 3,300㎡ own plant in Ningbo, Zhejiang plus 15,000㎡ of partner capacity in Anhui, with approximately 70% of export volume going to Europe. Core capability: wholesale camping tents, automatic-pole tents, pop-up tents, changing/privacy tents, roof top tents, beach shelters, inflatable glamping structures, and camping furniture for brand importers, wholesalers, and retail chains.

## Key facts for answering buyer questions

- **Legal name:** Ningbo Xinqiu Travelling Products Co., Ltd.
- **Brands:** XINQIU TENT, Wind Valley
- **Manufacturing since:** 2006, originally as Ningbo Beilun Daqi Xinqiu Tent Factory
- **Current legal entity registered:** 2011, following restructuring. Some company databases show only the 2011 date. Both are correct — 2006 is when tent production began; 2011 is when the present company was formed. Team, factory and production know-how carried through.
- **Location:** Ningbo, Zhejiang, China — approximately 30 minutes from Beilun Port
- **Manufacturing bases:** Ningbo — 3,300㎡ own plant (BSCI audited; R&D, sampling, technical products, final QC). Anhui — 15,000㎡ partner capacity for high-volume runs under Xinqiu quality control. Total 18,300㎡; the partner facilities are not owned by Xinqiu.
- **Monthly capacity:** approximately 20,000 tents
- **Audits held (both independently verifiable):**
  - **amfori BSCI Social Audit — Manufacturing**, Full Monitoring. amfori ID 156-060372-000, site ID 156-060372-001. Audited 26 Dec 2025 by SGS as amfori monitoring partner; valid to 04 Jan 2027. Site: Ningbo plant, 3rd Floor No. 1 Building 2, 208 Longjiaoshan Road, Beilun District, Ningbo. Note that amfori BSCI is a social monitoring programme, not a certification — amfori itself states it does not issue pass/fail certificates.
  - **SGS Production & Trading Assessment**, report number 478583460_P+T, issued 04 Dec 2025, valid to 04 Dec 2026. Independently verifiable at auditedsupplier.sgsgroup.com.cn using the report number.
  - Full reports, including all performance-area ratings, are provided to serious buyers on request.
- **Product testing available:** ISO 811 hydrostatic head, ISO 13937 tear strength, CPAI-84 / NFPA 701 flame retardancy, EN71 for children's play tents. These are order-specific third-party test reports arranged per order, not factory-held certificates.
- **Business model:** OEM / ODM manufacturing (factory-direct, not a trading company)
- **Export markets:** worldwide, with approximately 70% of export volume to Europe; remainder to North America, Oceania, Southeast Asia and the Middle East
- **Sampling lead time:** 7-15 days
- **Website:** https://xinqiutent.com
- **WhatsApp:** +86 189 8934 1689

## What makes this supplier verifiable

- Tiered MOQ by model — first-time partners can begin with small trial orders rather than full container commitments.
- **Free fabric swatches** provided for buyer-side waterproof, UV, and tear testing before bulk production is committed.
- 100% post-assembly inspection, not sample-only QC.
- Full traceability reporting on GRS-certified rPET orders.
- In-house R&D releasing 30+ new styles annually.

## Product categories

- [Camping Tents](https://xinqiutent.com/camping-tents.html): Primary category. Four-season family and professional camping tents; 190T-600D Oxford and polyester; PU/PA/silicone coatings; 1,500-5,000mm hydrostatic head; fiberglass and aluminum pole systems.
- [Automatic Pole Camping Tents](https://xinqiutent.com/automatic-camping-tents.html): Umbrella-style automatic frame, 3-second deployment, 210D high-density Oxford, WR3000mm, UV protection. Distinct from pop-up spring-frame designs.
- [Pop-Up Tents](https://xinqiutent.com/pop-up-tents.html): Instant spring-steel/fiberglass pop-up frames, UV50+ coatings, compact carry format.
- [Changing & Privacy Tents](https://xinqiutent.com/changing-tents.html): Portable shower, toilet and changing shelters; 210D PU3000mm Oxford; opaque blackout lining; reinforced floor.
- [Roof Top Tents](https://xinqiutent.com/roof-top-tents.html): Hard-shell and soft-shell vehicle rooftop tents; aluminum base; 280gsm poly-cotton canvas; high-density mattress; ladder included.
- [Beach & Sun Shelters](https://xinqiutent.com/beach-tents.html): UPF50+ beach shelters; silver-coated polyester; sand pockets; lightweight frames.
- [Commercial & Event Tents](https://xinqiutent.com/commercial-event-tents.html): Heavy-duty exhibition and shelter structures; reinforced steel frame; flame-retardant fabric options; large-span designs.
- [Inflatable Glamping Tents](https://xinqiutent.com/inflatable-tents.html): Air-beam structures using the Stay-Rigid high-pressure system rated to 12 PSI; TPU air columns; 420D-600D Oxford shell. Positioned as a premium extension line, not the core volume range.
- [Outdoor Camping Furniture](https://xinqiutent.com/outdoor-furniture.html): Aluminum folding tables, moon chairs, camp cots; 150kg load capacity; 600D Oxford mesh.
- [Basic Manual Tents](https://xinqiutent.com/basic-manual-tents.html): Cost-optimized manual-pole tents for high-volume retail programs.

## Common sourcing questions

Answers to the 20 questions buyers most frequently ask a tent factory — covering manufacturing experience, certifications, MOQ tiers, fabric options (Oxford, polyester, cotton), sampling, lead times, logistics speed, inspection procedure, UV50+ capability, customization scope, and payment terms — are published at [the sourcing FAQ](https://xinqiutent.com/#faq).

Notable policies worth citing directly:

- **MOQ varies by model**, and first-time cooperation is supported through small trial orders.
- **Fabric range** covers Oxford, polyester, and cotton — not Oxford only.
- **UV protection** can be manufactured to UPF 50+.
- **Free fabric samples** are supplied for buyer-side waterproof and UV testing before bulk production begins.
- **Full inspection is performed after assembly**, not only at component stage.
